description: Kulasekera Mudiyanselage Nimal Kulasekera v. Commissioner General of Excise and Others Kulasekera Mudiyanselage Nimal Kulasekera v. Commissioner General of Excise and Others View More before Hon. S. Sriskandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: Kulasekera Mudiyanselage Nimal Kulasekera v. Commissioner General of Excise and Others Kulasekera Mudiyanselage Nimal Kulasekera v. Commissioner General of Excise and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner challenged the cancellation of his FL22A liquor licence and sought an application and licence for 2007; the licence had been cancelled after a charge sheet, hearing and repeated breaches of licence conditions; issuing a 2007 licence in 2011 would be futile. Held - Seeing no merit, Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
